text_block_list.text:
Preparing for the upcoming off-campus 
community event had kept me until quite 
late.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uu, *sniffle*... It's scary, so 
scaaary...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hyah!! Ah, auu, Rice doesn't taste good 
even if you eat—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: .........H-huh? You're not... a ghost?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry for screaming! I was prepping 
for the exchange event, and before I knew 
it, it got this late.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was all alone, scared, in the dark... 
and couldn't move... I'm so glad someone 
is here...!
Daaaaaryaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah!? W-What is it this time...!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... Fufun. Nobody's here.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Alright! That's Turbo's win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-Turbo-san? What do you mean, a win...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...So, you were helping prepare for the 
event, fell asleep without realizing it—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-and heard footsteps behind you, so you 
ran away at full speed... Is that it...!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Turbo ran at full throttle! I don't 
hear ghost footsteps anymore, so Turbo 
wins!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... in movies, just when you think 
you've escaped, it turns out you actually 
haven't...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo never lets anyone catch up! Slow 
ghosts are nothing to be afra-a-aid of!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Nothing to be afraid of, you mean, um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...B-But still, moving through the dark is 
really scary...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Really? Rice, are you scared? Then Turbo 
will walk back with you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
In return, though, you gotta keep up with 
Turbo's full speed!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!?
choice_data_list:
Running together, it'll be over in a 
flash.
A ghost might be waiting in ambush.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I see... Y-Yeah, you're right. If we get 
out of the school building fast, it won't 
be scary anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Exact-ly! Turbo's a genius! Heh-hem!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, say "Ready, Set, Go"! The shoe 
lockers are the goal! Full dash all the 
way there!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Kyahahaha! Awesome, awesome! Our footsteps 
are echoing!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your laughter is echoing really 
loudly too, Turbo-san...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Kyahahaha! It really is! Come on, Rice, 
try laughing loudly too!

Through the quiet nighttime school 
building, the cheerful voices and 
footsteps of the two echoed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-The two of us...? That... is reassuring, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If you're with Rice, bad things will 
happen to you............

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...H-Hyaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ugyaaaaaah!? What!? What is it!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
J-Just now, in the w-window, there was a 
silhouette...!
choice_data_list: Isn't that just your own reflection?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Ah, you're right... Hau, I'm so 
sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No! A ghost definitely came!! Run! It's 
gonna catch us!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, Turbo-san, that's not it! It was 
just Rice's mistake...!
(*Slip!* *Crash!*)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Byaaaaah! Why is there a banana peel on 
the floor here of all places!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I'm sorry, Turbo-san...! Misfortune 
happened because you were with Rice...!

Creating chaos out of confusion, the two 
noisily dashed away...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What the heck!? That's such a sneaky 
ghost!

So I suggested that instead of running 
through the dark, we should all stick 
together and walk.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's probably safer not to run... 
...And if we're all together, it's not 
scary...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Mmmh... I see. Not running, huh...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Then Turbo will go check if anyone's 
waiting in ambush!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Turbo-san!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Wow, she's so dependable.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, wait. Rice is the older one here, so I 
have to do my best too...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! No ghosts here! Hurry, hurry! Let's 
goooo!!

Along with the energetic Twin Turbo and a 
softly smiling Rice Shower, we left the 
school building behind.
